summary: Biophytis SA filed a Form 6-K on June 16, 2026, announcing the temporary suspension of trading of its shares on Euronext Growth Paris due to a delay in preparing and publishing its annual financial report for FY2025. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other corporate action—is involved. The suspension is expected to last until the annual report is certified and published, likely by end of July 2026. This is a routine regulatory compliance matter, not a special situation.
